[SWS_CM_00216] Mapping of ara::com::e2e::TransportFaultCondition for Proxy
Methods
Status:
DRAFT
⌈
ara::com::e2e::TransportFaultConditionHandler
configured via
Skele-
ton::SetTransportFaultConditionHandler()
shall report one of the following
values for each transport error detected:
•
TransportFaultCondition::kSampleRejected
if the underlying request
DataReader
entity has signaled
SAMPLE_REJECTED
(e.g. due to corruption or
lack of storage resources)
•
TransportFaultCondition::kDeadlineMissed
if the underlying request
DataReader
has signaled
REQUESTED_DEADLINE_MISSED
(e.g. due to one or
more missed timing deadlines)
•
TransportFaultCondition::kSampleLost
if the underlying request
DataReader
has signaled
SAMPLE_LOST
(e.g. because one or more samples
have been detected to be lost)
⌋
